name: Inheruno
source:
The protagonist was taken in by relatives due to the sudden loss of his parents.
Just as he had begun to get used to his new life, a series of murders commenced.
Had he gone insane, or had his brother?
Or was it a demon?

Isn't the truth of the path you take insane?

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20041024034657/http://akumu9.hp.infoseek.co.jp:80/inhell.htm]author's page[/url]]
